title: Multiplication-normalized identity scalar extension on pro-etale ring sheaves
statement: Let $W$ be a scheme with small pro-etale site $W_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and let $R$ be a sheaf of commutative rings on it. Write $\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ for its category of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and $D(R)$ for its ordinary unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Use the actual scalar restriction and derived scalar extension functors, with their normalized adjunction, of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower]. For the identity ring map $1_R$, let $e_R:\operatorname{Res}_{1_R}\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Id}_{\operatorname{Mod}(R)}$ be the unique natural isomorphism whose component on every module sheaf is identity on every local section. Define $v_R:S_{1_R}=(-\otimes_R^L R)\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Id}_{D(R)}$ to be the left-adjoint comparison conjugate to the derived identity-section isomorphism $D(e_R):D(\operatorname{Res}_{1_R})\xrightarrow{\sim}\operatorname{Id}_{D(R)}$, using $S_{1_R}\dashv D(\operatorname{Res}_{1_R})$ and the identity adjunction. This is the scalar multiplication unit, not an arbitrary natural isomorphism. It is defined for every such $R$, including finite constant and completed integral coefficient sheaves, without boundedness, constructibility or flatness restrictions on derived inputs.
